sources.quote: AI was used only as a supporting tool in the creation of selected textures, sounds, localization and small portions of code. Due to our limited budget, it helped us create certain visual assets and game elements that would otherwise have been difficult to produce with the resources available to us. We deeply respect the work of real artists. The game’s concept, art direction, and design were created entirely by humans.
